page.layout: One page of text, one column; a woodcut ornament above the heading; a decorated initial at the start of the body; page number centred at the foot. No margin notes. Faint show-through from the reverse page is ignored.

main_text.head: GENERIS NOBILITATE, VIRTUTE ET LITERIS ORNATISSIMO adolescenti, Domino Josiæ à Wolmerchausen, amico meo honorando, Philippus Althusius U.J.D. Corbachensis salutem.
main_text.p: Ibellum hunc, nobilis. Domine Josia, in lucem adspectumque hominum producere & juris publici facere, autor Joannes Althusius patruelis meus dubitauit. Ego sub nomine ipsius edere minime dubitavi: Discedit in hoc passim à communi & huc usque recepta philosophorum sententia. Litium igitur occasio & materia dari videbatur. Paradoxa quoque

page.notes: The initial word "Libellum" is set as a decorated letter L with the rest of the word in small capitals ("IBELLUM"); transcribed as printed with the initial L joined. The first line of the heading has a woodcut ornament above it, not transcribed. Words in the page with faint show-through (e.g. "Sublimiore", "Diuinum") from the reverse side are not transcribed. Some letters in the body are uncertain: "Ibellum" may be "Libellum" with the L as decorative initial; "subnomine" printed as "sub nomine".
